ios.desc:
"Lost time is never found again" - Benjamin Franklin.

To improve your productivity, you need to first understand your current behaviors and where you have room for improvement. This is where Then comes in - a time tracking app that helps you record your activities, understand how well you spend your time, and improve your focus, productivity, and overall well-being.

With Then, it takes just seconds to start tracking your activities, and within a few days, you'll start to uncover patterns and gain insights into your daily life. You'll be able to see how much time you're spending on each activity and how it influences your mood, so you can make changes that lead to improved focus and productivity.

But it's not just about tracking your time - Then also helps you avoid burnout by monitoring your mental state. You can see what makes you happy, stressed, or tired, and adjust your habits to improve your overall well-being. And, with the option to export your data, you can even analyze it yourself to gain even deeper insights.

And, with its minimalistic and distraction-free design, Then makes time tracking a breeze. So, say goodbye to scattered thoughts, procrastination, and burnout, and hello to improved focus, productivity, and well-being. Download Then today and start building better time habits!



With Then, you'll be able to:

TRACK HOW YOU SPEND YOUR TIME

- Quickly track your activities and emotions to get a better understanding of how you're spending your time.
- Capture anything from focused work to leisure, exercise, and downtime.
- Choose from over 120 icons to personalize your activities.
- Easily make edits to past entries, so your data stays up-to-date.

STAY FOCUSED & PRODUCTIVE

- Keep a journal of all your daily activities and reflect on your timeline.
- Stay focused on the task at hand with a Lock Screen widget and Live Activity focus timer.
- Get reminders to keep up with your tracking, so you don't fall behind.
- At-a-glance view of your current activity with a home screen widget.

MONITOR YOUR MENTAL HEALTH

- Record your mood alongside your activities to see the impact they have on your emotions.
- Identify the positive and negative influences in your life.
- Monitor your work hours to avoid overworking and receive notifications when your planned activity is finished.

DISCOVER STATS, INSIGHTS & TRENDS

- Analyze how much time you spend on each activity daily, weekly, or in total.

quotes.text:
Then is an activity and mood diary that helps you analyze how you spend your time and how things you do influence your emotions. You can easily track what you do, how much time it takes, and how it makes you feel.

Whether you choose to focus on just one activity, like time spent working, or record everything you do during the day, detailed insights will help you identify patterns and get a breakdown of positive and negative influences in your daily life. Its goal is to offer a simple, clean and calming experience to help you be more mindful about your time and emotions.

You can download it on AppStore here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/then-activity-mood-diary/id1563184080#?platform=iphone
